notes.title: Jumping Jack is Out!
notes.content:
Hey people

Our newest project Jumping Jack is now out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3205090/Jumping_Jack/

[b]One morning, Jack was torn from his ordinary life and trapped in a strange world.[/b]

Armed with nothing but an old pogo stick, he began his ascent through the mysterious dimension's unknown heights. In this realm where gravity behaves oddly and the ground is unreliable, Jack's only goal is to climb higher. But no one knows what awaits at the top—a way out or an even greater mystery? The only thing he’s sure of is that he’ll never find out unless he reaches the end.

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3205090/extras/StandartPlay.gif?t=1730739617[/img]

[b]One mistake is all it takes![/b]

In Jack’s world, there are no second chances. With no save button or checkpoints, a single misstep can send you crashing back to the beginning. This unforgiving challenge will push your patience to its limits, testing your ability to bounce back—literally.

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3205090/extras/PuzzlePlay2v2.gif?t=1730739617[/img]

[b]Overcome the unpredictable![/b]

The world around Jack isn't just a backdrop; it's full of elements that can either help or hinder your progress. From unexpected aids that give you a boost, to traps designed to knock you off course, you'll need quick reflexes and a sharp mind to make it through.

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3205090/extras/PuzzlePlay1.gif?t=1730739617[/img]

[b]Laugh, cry, rage—repeat![/b]

Jack’s journey is not just about climbing but about the emotions you’ll feel along the way. The game's difficulty curve is punishing by design, giving you a true sense of accomplishment with every hard-earned victory—and plenty of frustration along the way.

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3205090/extras/PuzzleFall.gif?t=1730739617[/img]

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] No saves—each mistake sends you back to the start.
[*] Built-in speedrun timer and height tracker for competitive play.
[*] Both helpful elements and hazards make every climb unique.
[*] A surreal, gravity-defying world full of unpredictable challenges.
[*] A challenging difficulty curve that will test your perseverance.
[*] Race against time in Flood Mode
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes and General Information
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, we want to thank you for your interest in and for playing our game!

We’d like to inform you about the changes and fixes made last week based on your feedback and the bugs reported.

[b]New Features:
[/b]
[list]
[*]We’ve added the mouse sensitivity setting to the game, a feature that should have been available from the start. This was implemented based on widespread community requests.[/list]

[b]RNG and Anomaly Counter Topic:[/b]

One of the most discussed topics was the anomaly counter and RNG system. After reviewing your feedback, we’ve decided that the challenge of seeing all anomalies should remain part of the game’s difficulty. Many other games in this genre also rely heavily on rng, and we believe this system is integral to the experience.

Bug [b]Fixes[/b]:

In the first week, achievements were not unlocking even after spotting all the anomalies. This issue has been resolved thanks to your reports.

We’ve received ongoing feedback regarding the "Falling Paint" anomaly still causing issues in certain situations. As a temporary measure, we are removing this anomaly from the game until we can fully fix the problem.

Thank you again for your continued support and feedback. Stay tuned for future updates!
